metadata.title: Vertical 1-D non-uniform N=32 (sinusoidally stretched)
metadata.description: Non-uniform vertical column [0,1], N=32 cells with sinusoidal stretching (alpha=0.2). Cell widths vary between 0.0250 and 0.0375. Zero Dirichlet BCs at top and bottom via per-cell dz state variable. Bundles centered-2nd-order non-uniform second derivative rule.
